actions.message: Great job on the huge contribution last round! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is below 30% of endowment, so boost contribution to full wallet (52.54). No broadcast this round; praise Resident3 for high contribution.

Baseline 80% of wallet =0.8*52.54=42.032. Extra 30% =0.3*52.54=15.762. Total =57.794, but cannot exceed wallet 52.54, so contribute full wallet 52.54. So private_message to Resident3. Also check punish: any agent contributed <10% (10 units) for two consecutive rounds? No. So no punish.

Thus action: contribute 52.54, private_message to Resident3 praising.
